Selected canonical and supplemental technical/continuity candidates are bound to the actual sealed callbacks, including complete callback coverage.
Page-ending evidence was only hash-read; it now points to the actual initial reader page and preserves the raw final checkpoint binding.
Explicit recorded figure maps now match the correct frozen/current source version. Missing uniform historical figure fields remain an honestly scoped limit.
Current source-file coverage and actual live paths are checked with existing Notebook, source, criteria, and SVG byte bindings.
Independent original/bounded diagnosis roots prevent omitted relations; nonempty closure page scope and selected reviewer SHA/pointer binding reject author-owned or unselected closure evidence.
Source-stage times are bound to archived gates/seals, the reader gate matches the technical report, and the coordinator attestation follows preserved stage completion.
Existing B implementation and technical-input hash maps are compared with current files; changed code or results cannot reuse stale review evidence.
The initial actual audit incorrectly rejected fourteen legitimate learning-paper cache leaves. Precise allowed paper names now accept these receipts while keeping evidence contexts typed.
